game.title: Redfall
game.blurb: Open-world vampire-hunting first-person shooter, solo or in co-op, from Arkane Austin, released 2023-05-01 (RAWG date). RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Redfall Commons
chapters.summary: The main missions of the first region, its first safehouse, neighborhoods and the Hollow Man. Hidden achievements sit here too.

chapters.title: Burial Point
chapters.summary: The main missions of the second region, its neighborhoods and the vampire gods Bloody Tom, Miss Whisper and The Black Sun.

chapters.title: Mission Feats
chapters.summary: Optional ways to finish named missions, such as One of Us, Fall Like Lightning and the Psychic Woods.

chapters.title: Side Missions and Secrets
chapters.summary: Optional and side missions, grave locks, family secrets and odd discoveries around the island.

chapters.title: Vampires and Nests
chapters.summary: Staking vampires, every vampire type, nest doors and nest hearts.

chapters.title: Heroes, Trust and Loot
chapters.summary: Trust with Layla, Devinder, Jacob and Remi, blood remnants, unrivaled items and tripwires.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Redfall" or "Redfall (video game)". redfall.fandom.com answers the API but has no "Redfall" page, so Fandom is unverified. RAWG gives 2023-05-01 as the release date. Steam app 1294810 is "Redfall". Only 6 of 66 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the Redfall Commons chapter as a placeholder, though some ("Avenging the Good Doctor", "Say Goodbye, Joe") may come later. The region chapters follow the two regions the achievements name; "Mission Feats" holds achievements tied to a named mission, which the data does not place in a region. "From the Shadows" (Gloria during The Key to Wellness) and "Harvest's End" (The Harvestman during The Festival) are mission feats too.
